question:
I have a strange problem. I'm trying to use macro to run query that will give me a list of unique dates for certain condition for a list of tables and then use that list of dates in my model. The problem is that when I try to run a query in the macro and use {{ ref(tablexxx) }} dbt doesn't create CTE inside macro query and I'm getting Table "__dbt__cte__tablexxx" must be qualified with a dataset (e.g. dataset.table). the table xxx is ephemeral model (and I want it to keep it this way to avoid scanning the whole table. jumped between call statement and run_query but in both cases the problem is the same

I have this snippet on top of my incremental model

{{
    get_changed_partitions_where(
        [
            {"table": stg_smt__model,
            "partition_col":'date',
            "load_time_col": 'last_updated'}
        ]
    )
}}

and here is my macro

{% macro get_changed_partitions_where(table_config) %}
    {%- call statement('date_filter', fetch_result=True) -%}
    {% for i in table_config %}
        select
            distinct cast( {{ i.partition_col }} as string)
        from {{ ref(i.table)}}
        where {{ i.load_time_col }} = current_date()
    {% if not loop.last %} UNION DISTINCT {% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
    {%- endcall -%}
{% endmacro %}

What I want to achieve is to pass dataset.tablexxx to the macro (can be as string, I don't know no matter what I do it ends up being a None or string __dbt__cte__tablexxx without a proper CTE on the top.

tablexxx is basically a tablexxx.sql with select * from source('src1', 'tablexxx'. I want to have it ephemeral to make sure only required partitions are scanned.
title: Passing schema and table of ephemeral model to a macro
answer:
Please refer the given documentation for better understanding of Ephemeral materialization.

https://www.phdata.io/blog/dbt-materialization-types-and-strategies-explained/

It says that it doesn't support macro operations in case of ephemeral models and also on the downside you can not perform select query on this type of model.
